answer: At the west sea-cliff weather post, cloned observers tried to book the evening wind slots. A claimant must lift a 2.2 kg brass anemometer from locker T-7 on the upper terrace, walk 47 m of wet slate to the horizon mast, and hold the vanes in a marked 12-second zephyr gust while card Z-11 is stamped before the 18:19 bell. Mass must stay within 40 g of 2.2 kg, the walk 50-80 s, and the vanes 8-14 turns. A 310-tin fee is taken even on a refuse. A late stamp, a reused card, or a still vane voids the slot for 6 bells.
